name: Fertilizers & Chemicals Travancore Ltd
about: Fertilizers & Chemicals Travancore Ltd (FACT), incorporated in the year 1943, is the first large-scale fertiliser plant in India at Udyogamandal, Kochi, Kerala. The company is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of fertilizers, its by-products and Caprolactam. It is under the administrative control of the Department of Fertilizers, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Government of India.[1]
keyPoints: Product Profile:[1] FACT manufactures complex fertiliser Factamfos (NP 20:20:0:13), Ammonium Sulphate and trades products such as Muriate of Potash, NPK fertilisers and organic manures. It also has a Caprolactam plant and sells gypsum and engineering services.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter

Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 40.2%
cons: Stock is trading at 37.5 times its book value
